review.method: Visual review with local Whisper transcript support

steps.title: Prepare the collar
steps.instruction: Fasten the top shirt button and put the cravat around the collar.

steps.title: Set the blade lengths
steps.instruction: Set one blade end level with the top shirt button.

steps.title: Cross the blades
steps.instruction: Cross one blade over the other blade.

steps.title: Wrap the long blade
steps.instruction: Move the long blade around the back, across the front, and upward.

steps.title: Form the knot
steps.instruction: Pass the long blade through and keep the knot loose and full.

steps.title: Tighten the cravat
steps.instruction: Push the short blade through the front and adjust the knot upward.

steps.title: Shape the finish
steps.instruction: Shape a large knot that covers the top button.
